removed_lines: . what ’s on in our parish: parish surgery —there will be no parish surgery this monday 14th september as canon robert away on retreat. prayer & communion services— on monday 14th and wednesday 16th september by deacon james in dundrum at 9.30am. the service will be lay led on tuesday 15th september. st carlo acutis— many thank to the parishioners who purchased medals, prayer cards and candles. a young gent after mass spoke to canon robert and decon james informing them he had met st carolo acutis ’ mother in paris—how special! parish fundraising concert on friday 18th september –countdown on for this event! parishioners and friends are requested to be seated by 6.45pm please. parish pastoral council members will be available to provided help in carpark and chapel. “helpers ” would be most welcome to come along to tidy chapel on monday 14th september at 7pm and setup community centre on thursday 17th september at 7pm. not too late to purchase ticket! we hope everyone has an enjoyable evening. canon robert —will be away on retreat after mass on sunday the 13th september until wednesday 16th september inclusive. please contact mary polland for any emergencies
